title: Design and synthesis of novel cyclohexanecarboxamides with anticonvulsant effect by activating Nrf2-ARE pathway.
authors: Abd-Allah, Walaa H; Abdel-Maksoud, Mohammed S; Elbaset, Marawan A; Korany, Reda M S; Ibrahim, Ibrahim M; Hassan, Rasha M
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成环己烷甲酰胺类抗惊厥药物，通过激活Nrf2-ARE通路发挥神经保护作用，分子对接和动力学模拟仅针对Nrf2蛋白与小分子，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigated a series of novel cyclohexanecarboxamide derivatives 4a-e, 5a-e and 6a-e as anticonvulsant and neuroprotective agents. Compounds 4a-e, 5a-e, and 6a-e were synthesized starting from cyclohexanone and aniline derivatives and evaluated for their anticonvulsant effects using maximal electroshock (MES) and subcutaneous pentylenetetrazole (scPTZ) seizure models. The most potent compounds 4b, 5c, and 6d demonstrated 83.33 % protection in the scPTZ test, while compounds 5a and 6b showed 100 % protection in the MES test. Further quantitative evaluation showed that compound 6d was the most active derivative in scPTZ test (ED(50) = 0.04 mmol/kg) and it was more potent than the two reference drugs phenobarbital and ethosuximide by 1.7 and 25.7-fold, respectively. Notably, all the compounds were free from neurotoxic side effects. Mechanistic studies indicated that the compounds 4b, 5c, and 6d exerted neuroprotective effects by modulating oxidative stress markers and activating the Nrf2/ARE pathway. Histopathological examination of brain of animals treated with compounds 4b, 5c, or 6d corroborated the neuroprotective properties. Additionally, molecular docking study and dynamic simulations were also carried out to study the mechanism of Nrf2 activation by the most active compound 6d. These results spotlight the potential of these derivatives as promising candidates for further development as anti-epileptic and neuroprotective agents.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了一系列新型环己烷甲酰胺衍生物4a-e、5a-e和6a-e作为抗惊厥和神经保护剂。以环己酮和苯胺衍生物为起始原料合成了化合物4a-e、5a-e和6a-e，并通过最大电休克（MES）和皮下戊四唑（scPTZ）癫痫模型评估了其抗惊厥作用。最有效的化合物4b、5c和6d在scPTZ试验中显示出83.33%的保护作用，而化合物5a和6b在MES试验中显示出100%的保护作用。进一步的定量评估表明，化合物6d是scPTZ试验中最活跃的衍生物（ED(50) = 0.04 mmol/kg），其效力分别比两种参考药物苯巴比妥和乙琥胺强1.7倍和25.7倍。值得注意的是，所有化合物均无神经毒性副作用。机制研究表明，化合物4b、5c和6d通过调节氧化应激标志物并激活Nrf2/ARE通路发挥神经保护作用。对用化合物4b、5c或6d处理的动物大脑的组织病理学检查证实了其神经保护特性。此外，还进行了分子对接研究和动态模拟，以探讨最活跃化合物6d激活Nrf2的机制。这些结果凸显了这些衍生物作为抗癫痫和神经保护剂进一步开发的潜在候选药物的前景。
